rationale: With only 7 minutes to close, the stock has already pulled back from its intraday high of $11.37 and is showing a series of declining candles (from $11.12 down to $10.96), suggesting momentum is fading. The active securities fraud class action lawsuit creates significant downside headline risk, and the position in the range at 87.7% with a forced market-close liquidation in 7 minutes makes both long and short entries unfavorable — a long risks further deterioration into close, while a short risks a sudden squeeze in a high-relative-volume name. The risk/reward does not justify entry at this stage of the session.
